name: Ultimate Spider-Man Vita
author: boomannotjeff
description: A PS Vita port of Ultimate Spider-Man (PC, 2005), made by statically recompiling the PC game's USM.exe to C (every x86 instruction becomes equivalent C, like N64Recomp / XenonRecomp), then running that on the Vita with its own Windows, Direct3D 9, DirectSound and input layer on top of vitaGL.
